note: How many crew must be on the clock at once for a unit-shift to count as a
unit that ran. UHU's denominator is unit hours actually crewed, so a
profile rostered with one person contributes nothing -- which is the point:
anything but a wheelchair or secure car needs two, a licensed clinician
default_min_crew applies to every profile with no matching pattern.
by_pattern maps a case-insensitive substring of the shift profile name to
the crew that profile needs, longest pattern first. Only the operation
knows which of its names mean wheelchair or secure car work, so list them
here rather than relying on a naming convention that could change.
Rename to unit_staffing_rules.json to put it in effect.
unit_staffing_rules.proposed.json listing every profile it saw with the
crew it was scored as, ready to edit and rename.
